_comment: Coronado's two shark-monitoring hubs (CSULB Shark Lab, owned by the City of Coronado and kept by its lifeguards) and the receiver on each. IDs, not coordinates: which break a hub serves is derived each collection from the hub's own position against forecast/spots.json (collector.sharklab), never typed. A receiver swap shows as a warning when a hub's detections name another receiver; the owner updates this file.
